title: AnonyMatch
tagline: Matches had never been incentivized before. Connect with people Onchain in a fun, interesting, anonymous and trustworthy way.
description:
AnonyMatch is an application that connects through your World ID or World App Wallet. This protects the user's information, guaranteeing that the person you are interacting with is verified and belongs to an onchain community. 

Connect with people with common interests, similar conversations, admirable skills... People from different parts of the world in the same ecosystem.
how_its_made:
The frontend was made using Motiff as inspiration and then moved to figma for user interaction. Canva was used for logo design. With Vercel, the reactive code was removed to remove the frontend.

The NextJS Template has been used to build the mini app on the frontend and backend.
For the matching system with the ia we have integrated the google gemini sdk and for the real time chat management we will use the firebase database.
